force: native P_I_kN only, no sign flip; native P/U1 conjugate sign remains an external condition
deformation: U1_m; y=d-d0; force column F-F0; no intercept
model: d-d0 = a*(F-F0) + b*integral_0^t sign(F)*abs(F)^(1/alpha) dt; a=1/k>0; b=c^(-1/alpha)>0
integration: Cumulative trapezoid on every original output time; sign(0)=0; no resampling, smoothing or time differentiation
linear_solver: 2-column least squares after positive column 2-norm scaling; enumerate feasible unconstrained interior, a-only, b-only and zero NNLS active sets; nonnegative boundaries retained and labelled, not treated as finite physical k/c
selection: Minimum K2 full-grid SSE only; deterministic first alpha on exact ties; no K5 tuning
profile: Save all 91 alpha rows, unconstrained a/b, constrained active set, rank and raw/scaled singular values/condition number, K2 errors and K5 transferred-parameter errors in m and mm
descriptive_profile_ranges: Save alpha sets within 1%,5%,10% of minimum K2 RMSE; descriptive only, not confidence intervals. A 5%-set span >=0.20 is labelled broad; a sharp grid minimum still does not prove unique physical parameters.
residuals: Keep all 2501 times for each device including zeros and small/difficult points; no trimming or response-wise normalization

optional_screenshot_check.interpretation: Conditional on these units only; not exported true properties or fit constraints

limits: K5 is the same RH4X record on another device, not independent-earthquake validation. Fit cannot prove force sign, attached-mass identity, Maxwell model completeness, physical parameter uniqueness or all-device energy closure.
